detail.description:
😫 Stuck in a loop of endless tasks and screen fatigue?
🧩 Unwind with Woodle Screw™! Experience the ultimate wood puzzle where satisfying unscrewing mechanics meet addictive match-3 clearing. Remove the pins, match the colors, and let the ASMR sounds melt your stress away.

🕹️ Gameplay
In this ultimate screw game, your goal is to clear the board, collect keys, and rebuild an entire city.
· Match 3 screws of the same color to clear them from the board.
· Plan your moves carefully before unscrew

What's New:
- You can get various coin bundles and prop bundles in the shop.

We hope you enjoy the update!
Please leave us a review if you like the game.
Thank you for playing Woodle Screw™ Pin Nuts & Bolts :)
